LanguageData.RK_Thing_ArchotechTail.description: An artificial ratkin tail built by an archotech. It senses posture and micro-movements to keep the bearer perfectly balanced, feels like living flesh, and is harder to damage than plasteel. If harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its inner workings are a mystery.
LanguageData.RK_Thing_ArchotechTail.label: archotech ratkin tail
